comparison.objective: Unload a soup tray from a pass shelf and serve its bowl without spilling.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual tray extraction and leveling followed by careful bowl transfer.
comparison.success_condition: Tray lies flat, bowl reaches the placemat, and no more than 10 ml-equivalent spills; severe tipping fails.
comparison.reason: Load stabilization and spill avoidance are meaningfully different from fine fastener/collar manipulation and measured damper response.
